name: Lahad
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Lahad is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through Shobal. He is the son of Jahath and belongs to the lineage of the tribe of Judah. He is known only from a genealogical record and has no further narrative attached to him in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Lahad is listed as the son of Jahath in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Zorathite Lineage
keyEvents.description: Lahad belongs to the lineage referred to as the descendants of the Zorathites, descendants of Shobal who was a son of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Placed in the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Through his connection to Judah's lineage, Lahad is part of the tribe that later gave rise to David's royal house.

keyEvents.title: Brother of Ahumai
keyEvents.description: Lahad is mentioned together with his brother Ahumai as sons of Jahath in the genealogical record.
